# metal-cpp

Apple's C++ interface to Metal, copied unchanged from the `metal-cpp_macOS15.2_iOS18.2.zip`
archive on https://developer.apple.com/metal/cpp/ (downloaded 2026-10-14). Its license is the
Apache License 2.0 in `LICENSE.txt`. OfxGrip vendors it so the Metal backend (phase 1) builds
without an Objective-C class in the plug-in, per the in-process build rules in the host libraries
plan. Update by replacing this directory with a newer archive's `metal-cpp/` folder and recording
the archive name here.
